name: Lia Parapara Leazas
original_name: リア・パラパラ・リーザス
source:
Lia Parapara Leazas is the recently crowned Queen of Leazas. [spoiler]Her hobby used to be torturing girls, but ever since [url=/c735]Rance[/url] punished her for it, she has been restrained from further kidnappings. She is obsessed with Rance, her love for him is so intense that she would give him the entire country if he asked. She refers to Rance as "Darling".[/spoiler]

Leazas has prospered under her rule, even though she was recently coronated. However, many nobles hate her and her ways and have tried to take her down in the past or even go as far as assisting enemy countries.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Lia_Parapara_Leazas]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
